paper_title: Virtual Category-Guided Continual Generalized Category Discovery
venue: Author arXiv comments report ECCV2026 acceptance; proceedings independently unverified
official_binding: Author arXiv2607.04984v1 abstract directly links this repository; latest inspected source is not independently bound to paper experiment release
license: MIT2026VC-CGCDAuthors fully read. vision_transformer.py Facebook Apache2.0 header read. No source copied, installed or executed
paper_read_scope: Abstract/intro/preliminaries, methods3.2-3.4, setup4.1, comparison/ablation text4.2-4.3, conclusion5 and limitationsE.1-E.2; not full supplementary algorithms or visual figures
original_task: Known-labelled offline initialization followed by full-session unlabeled image continual generalized category discovery
model_inputs: DINO ViTB16 weak/strong augmented image views, projection/weight-normalized classifier and current-session feature-bank neighbors; supplied entry also passes true dataset labels to VC loss
model_outputs: Parametric class logits plus per-sample virtual logit during training; expansion size uses benchmark novel class counts. Evaluation outputs classifier argmax then external GT-Hungarian remap
losses: Offline KnownCE+SupCon, detached cross-view distillation and entropy regularization. Session training distillation/group-wise entropy, expanded-neighbor CE, hardness-aware Gaussian prototype augmentation, previous-feature distillation and VC CE
training_protocol: Shuffled whole-session minibatch SGD and multi-epoch fitting, not frozen pretrained-only inference. Default100offline/30online epochs, four sessions, lastViTblock trainable. Test accuracy selects saved best checkpoint that seeds next session
online_or_offline: Session-incremental training on available full-session pool, with optional whole-session clustering. Not per-frame irrevocable deployment predictions or mutation-certified current-frame causal stream
static_reproducibility_findings_not_meas: Complete pinned tree has models/__pycache__/vc.cpython-38.pyc but lacks imported models/vc.py. Bytecode is not reviewed/executed as a substitute for readable VCClassifier/WeightGenerator/VCHAP source

Online train.py400 passes class_labels.repeat(2) into VCloss although mask_lab is zero. VCloss138-140 prefers any valid0<=target<K non-ignore ground-truth label on nonconfusing samples. MergedUnlabelledDataset and CIFAR wrappers retain labels, and get_datasets remaps them into the classifier range. This supplied path is not label-free; its actual end-to-end execution is not claimed

train.py890-902 counts unique true novel labels to set num_cur_novel_classes and945 classifier size; num_novel_class_per_session also derives from benchmark class-set sizes. This is oracle cardinality, not an unknown-K discovery protocol
Offline and online best models are chosen by disjoint test accuracy; subsequent sessions load that best checkpoint. Cannot import this selection into locked TAO Val

Optimizer is built from student at306-307 before new student_classifier337; new VC-specific head is not in those parameter groups unless shared elsewhere. Missing VCHAP source prevents complete gradient/update audit

Expanded-neighbor implementation hardcodes256 rows/features and reportsK*K expanded neighbors despite constructingK*expanded_K; defaultK4 andexpanded_K1 differ. Paper-described adaptive margin and FAISS-neighbor active path are not established in this inspected torch-based function

evaluation: Global Hungarian matching remaps classifier predictions, including Known, at each test set. All/Old/New ACC and forgetting/discovery summaries do not certify fixed Known IDs or persistent cross-video category tokens
state_memory: Offline labelled visual prototypes retained; session novel prototypes are predicted-label means after best-checkpoint load, with FC-weight fallback. No inspected reversible category-event log, quarantine, split/merge lineage or versioned public prediction repair
what_to_borrow: Only ambiguity-buffer/candidate-set and lawful multi-positive representation hypotheses; independently design with observed prefixes and Train-only supervision/calibration
what_not_to_borrow: True online labels/cardinality, test-selected checkpoints, unread bytecode as source, virtual class as persistent category token, full-session replay as dense causal inference or optimal remapping as fixed Known accuracy
